what: The commenter says free Google Sheets templates kept breaking when they tried to tweak the formulas.
verbatim_snippet:
"i totally get you, i started with the free google sheets templates too, but tbh i always ended up breaking the formulas whenever i tried to tweak them.

what finally worked for me was buying a premade family budget spreadsheet on etsy. mine came with recurring bills, monthly tabs, and even a dashboard that shows where the money's going (which was a lifesaver for me cause i'm not formula savvy at all)."
notes: Page shows relative date only; thread archived.
